name: Corporate Brain
description: Kinetic Data's institutional memory: companies, people, events, decisions and knowledge, every claim traceable to evidence and human-reviewed.

forms.name: Companies
forms.description: Organizations: customers, prospects, partners, vendors and Kinetic itself

forms.name: People
forms.description: Individuals and their history with Kinetic

forms.name: Relationships
forms.description: Typed many-to-many links between entities by stable ID (never by display name)

forms.name: Communications
forms.description: Email, meeting and conversation metadata (bodies stay in the source system)

forms.name: Historical Events
forms.description: Significant dated events; never overwritten when later information arrives

forms.name: Decisions
forms.description: Business and technical decisions with context, rationale and alternatives

forms.name: Knowledge Entries
forms.description: Facts, interpretations, narratives, lessons, claims and recollections — each with evidence and review status

forms.name: Sources
forms.description: References to original evidence; the source system stays authoritative for content

forms.name: Projects
forms.description: Customer implementations and internal projects

forms.name: Products
forms.description: Kinetic products and major capabilities

forms.name: Research Jobs
forms.description: Historical research and ingestion jobs with checkpoints, counters and errors

forms.name: Sales Principles
forms.description: Rules Kinetic follows when selling, in the founders' words, backed by the deals where they showed up

forms.name: Pricing Models
forms.description: Licensing and pricing models over time: when each started and ended, its price points and why it changed

forms.name: Deals
forms.description: One opportunity: the ask, the competition, the outcome and the reason (prices live in Deal Pricing)

forms.name: Deal Pricing
forms.description: Quoted and final prices, discounts and terms for a deal — restricted to Sales, Legal and Executive

forms.name: Sales Objections
forms.description: What customers pushed back on, and the responses that worked or failed

forms.name: Competitors
forms.description: Who Kinetic met in deals, and where it won or lost against them

forms.name: Partner Models
forms.description: Reseller, referral, OEM and teaming arrangements and their terms over time

forms.name: RFP Sources
forms.description: A procurement (RFP, RFQ, RFI, questionnaire) and its documents; unknown dates and outcomes stay unknown

forms.name: RFP Documents
forms.description: One revision of one procurement document; the original file is kept as an attachment and never changed

forms.name: RFP Questions
forms.description: A question exactly as a procurement asked it, where it sits in the document, and its extraction review state

forms.name: RFP Historical Answers
forms.description: The exact answer Kinetic gave (or drafted) in one document revision; immutable once confirmed — corrections are new revisions

forms.name: Canonical Questions
forms.description: One subject many historical questions share; each keeps its own wording and its own answers

forms.name: Approved Answers
forms.description: Current reusable answers, approved by a reviewer for stated product versions and environments, with evidence and a review date

forms.name: RFP Analyses
forms.description: A new RFP analysed against the question library: a reviewable requirements matrix of AI-generated drafts

forms.name: RFP Analysis Items
forms.description: One requirement of a new RFP with its AI-generated draft, the evidence it used and its review

forms.name: Audit Log
forms.description: Append-only record of material changes by users and agents (review decisions, merges, ingestion writes)
